releases.body:
## [3.0.0](https://github.com/pedropombeiro/opencode-plugins/compare/opencode-forgekeeper-2.4.1...opencode-forgekeeper-3.0.0) (2026-11-05)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **forgekeeper:** Review notifications now go to the inbox by default. `resumeSession` and the former option names are removed. Configure `delivery.reviews` and `delivery.lifecycle` as `"passive"` or `"summary"` to post updates to sessions. See the [README’s upgrade guide](https://github.com/pedropombeiro/opencode-plugins/blob/main/packages/forgekeeper/README.md#upgrade-from-forgekeeper-2x) for the option mapping.

### Features

* **forgekeeper:** monitor reviews and MR changes in a feedback inbox ([#123](https://github.com/pedropombeiro/opencode-plugins/issues/123)) ([a3adebb](https://github.com/pedropombeiro/opencode-plugins/commit/a3adebbd42396cab15f89bfaf31691467a0ed19f))
